risk_summary: The company reports severe liquidity distress, only $1,169 in cash, recurring monthly cash deficits, no adequate financing or assets, and substantial past-due and related-party obligations. Operations remain dependent on uncertain oil production improvements and successful capital raising, while creditor or officer repayment demands could materially impair liquidity and threaten viability. Although losses declined, the improvement was substantially driven by reduced non-cash stock compensation and debt settlements rather than demonstrated operating profitability.
